uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-890449 --sweep age=42:66:7 --sweep thal=3,7

findings.statement: Through it, older age raises the predicted risk steadily up to about 56 years ..., then no further for most patients, but for patients with a reversible defect on the thallium scan it rises in a jump
findings.evidence: the model does the opposite: with a reversible defect the part is off at every age and the typical patient stays at 41.9% from 42 to 66 years; the rise (11.8% at 42 to 28.5% from 54 on) happens with a normal scan. The cited threshold claim C37 is conditioned on patients with a normal thallium scan, and C33 says age acts only without a reversible defect
commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify probe experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-890449 --sweep age=42:66:7 --sweep thal=3,7
